title: Goblin Memorabilia
body:
""

Description

The Goblin Memorabilia stands as a unique statue, exclusively available for purchase at the Magma Cave Shop nestled within the depths of the Magma Caves.

However, acquiring this item isn't as straightforward as browsing a shelf. To obtain the Goblin Memorabilia, players must climb along the wooden beams positioned just above the store's entrance. Utilizing tools like the Gravity Coil or Fusion Coil is essential to access the higher points unreachable by standard jump height.

Upon climbing the beams you will encounter a small Greedy Greeb Goblin nestled within a small hole. Maneuvering into this hidden space, players will then navigate further, descending through another opening. Here, they'll discover multiple Goblins gathered around the statue. It can then be taken to the Store counter to be purchased for $75,000

Trivia

The Description of the Goblin Memorabilia is encoded. Upon decoding it with Base64, then shifting it a couple of times in Caesars Cipher until the following sentence was built:

According to all known laws of aviation, there is no way a greedy greeb goblin should be able to fly. Its wings are too small to get its fat little body of the ground. The greedy greeb goblin, of course, flies anyway, because greedy greeb goblins dont care what humans think is possible.
